age.evidence: 28 adult male (12-24 months old) Sert + / + and Sert + / -mice on a C57BL/6J background

sex.evidence: 28 adult male (12-24 months old) Sert + / + and Sert + / -mice

dosing.evidence: Animals (14 per genotype) were randomly assigned to receive intraperitoneal (i.p.) injections of either LSD or volume-matched saline. The LSD dose (0.32 mg/kg) was chosen here as a behaviorally active dose in mice

handling.evidence: Paper does not mention handling prior to testing.

group_housing.evidence: housed 3-4 mice per cage with ad libitum access to solid food pellets and water

day_night_flipped.evidence: Animals were maintained on a 12:12 light:dark cycle. All studies were performed between 11:00 and 15:00 during the light cycle

enrichment_housing.evidence: Paper does not mention environmental enrichment in the home cage.

assays.assay_name: Self-grooming and serotonin syndrome-like behavior observation
assays.assay_description: Individual mice placed in a clear observation cylinder (13 cm diameter, 15 cm height) for a 10 min session immediately after i.p. injection. Manual scoring of self-grooming (latency, bouts, duration) and a panel of SS-like and general activity behaviors (hindleg rearing, wall leans, flat body posture, Straub tail, head twitching, head shaking, trunk tremors, hindleg abductions, backward gait, fecal boli).

application_type.evidence: intraperitoneal (i.p.) injections of either LSD or volume-matched saline

setup_habituation.evidence: Mice were transported from their holding room to the testing room and allowed at least 1 h for acclimation. Animals were individually placed in a clear behavioral observation cylinder... for self-grooming measurement

setup_restrain.evidence: Animals were individually placed in a clear behavioral observation cylinder (13 cm in diameter, 15 cm height) for self-grooming measurement

food_restriction.evidence: Standard short observation in a clear cylinder with no food access during recording (ad libitum food in home cage).

water_restriction.evidence: Standard short observation in a clear cylinder with no water access during recording (ad libitum water in home cage).

time_to_assay.evidence: I.p. injections were performed by the same experimenter immediately before behavioral observation

sample_size.evidence: 28 adult male (12-24 months old) Sert + / + and Sert + / -mice on a C57BL/6J background (n = 7 per group; 4 groups)

outcomes.summary: Sert+/- mice showed increased grooming duration vs wild-type regardless of LSD treatment. Acute LSD (0.32 mg/kg) significantly increased serotonin-syndrome-like behaviors (head twitching, trunk tremor, backward gait) in both genotypes, but did not affect grooming measures. No significant genotype × treatment interactions were observed.
outcomes.statistics: Grooming duration: F(1,24)=9.517, p<0.005 (genotype); F(1,24)=0.090, p=0.77 (LSD). Head twitching: F(1,24)=15.882, p<0.001. Trunk tremor: F(1,24)=4.322, p<0.05. Backward gait: F(1,24)=7.513, p<0.05.
outcomes.evidence: Sert +/- mice displayed a longer duration of self-grooming behavior regardless of LSD treatment. In contrast, LSD increased serotonin-sensitive behaviors, such as head twitching, tremors and backwards gait behaviors in both Sert +/+ and Sert +/- mice.

B1_num_measures.evidence: Observers measured the latency to first grooming bout, total number of bouts, total duration of grooming, hindleg rearing, wall leans, flat body posture, Straub tail reactions, head twitching, head shaking, trunk tremors, hindleg abductions, backwards gait behavior, and number of fecal boli.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Data reported as totals over the 10 min session; no within-session time-course analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of transitions, sequences, or bout microstructure reported in this study.

B4_ethological.evidence: Rodent self-grooming is a complex, evolutionarily conserved patterned behavior; grooming bouts, rearing, and other natural behaviors were scored.

B5_social.evidence: Animals were individually placed in a clear behavioral observation cylinder.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Spontaneous behavior observation without learning or memory component.

B7_automated_classification.evidence: Manual recording of self-grooming for 10 min by two highly trained observers.

B8_multivariate.evidence: All data were analyzed by two-way analysis of variance (ANOVA) on individual measures; no dimensionality reduction.

E1_environment_type.evidence: clear behavioral observation cylinder (13 cm in diameter, 15 cm height)

E2_shelter.evidence: Clear cylinder without shelter or refuge.

E3_bedding.evidence: No bedding described in observation cylinder.

E6_spatial.evidence: Single observation cylinder without distinct compartments.

E7_social_context.evidence: Animals were individually placed in a clear behavioral observation cylinder.

E8_food_water.evidence: No food or water in observation cylinder during testing.

D1_continuity.evidence: Each mouse was observed for a single 10 min session.

D2_session_duration.evidence: manual recording of self-grooming for 10 min

D4_baseline.evidence: Injections performed immediately before behavioral observation; no pre-drug baseline recording.

D6_circadian.evidence: 10 min session does not span >=6 hours.

judge_notes: All three candidates identified a single behavioural assay (observation cylinder for grooming + SS-like behaviors); consolidated as one assay.
B1: counted ≥13 distinct behavioural measures (3 grooming + 10 other), scored 7+ = 3 points. Candidate glm's value label '4-6' was inconsistent with their own score of 3; corrected to '7+'.
Age set to 'aged' given 12-24 months old mice (>18 months is typically considered aged in mice). Used 365-730 days for age_min/max.
Food/water restriction set to 'during' (standard short test, no food/water in cylinder, ad libitum in home cage) with high confidence.
setup_habituation scored 'no' — paper describes room acclimation (1 h) but no apparatus pre-exposure, which per rubric is room habituation not setup habituation.
